items.q: Dave Tuft. Joe Jones, all these kinds of people used to come down every night.

ctx.x: Dave Tuft. Joe Jones, all these kinds of people used to come down every night. You know. And they had a big furnace downstairs, this was, we'd go
downstairs and turn on. We'd go down there and learn to smoke pot. But it was fantastic, but from seven to four seven nights a week.
